blocks.corrected_text: • Equation (1.3) is valid for any sign of q₁ and q₂ whether positive or negative. If q₁ and q₂ are of the same sign (either both positive or both negative), F₂₁ is along r̂₂₁, which denotes repulsion, as it should be for like charges. If q₁ and q₂ are of opposite signs, F₂₁ is along – r̂₂₁(= r̂₁₂), which denotes attraction, as expected for unlike charges.
